correctness.rationale: Every valid inverse occurs at an eight-letter palindrome. Overlapping valid windows with displacement one force a constant nine-letter span, and displacement two forces abbaabbaab, producing identical parents. Distinct parents thus require starts separated by at least three. The length-(n+4) prefix of (aab)^omega has legal starts every three and yields pairwise distinct parents, providing equality for all n>=4 and all q>=2. The packaged independent checker reproduced 5,037,919 finite received-word tests and symbolic overlap identities.

value.rationale: This determines the exact natural inverse ambiguity of a fixed-length DNA-storage duplication channel at every source length and alphabet size. It improves the leading worst-case inverse-list constant from 1 to 1/3 at k=4, with a structural distance-two collision lemma and explicit extremizers. This bound enters finite-length decoding and multi-error counting arguments, rather than merely recomputing a published table.
